candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student AI / ML position. Medical imaging AI is where my most meaningful machine learning work has been, and helping your team compare and validate models that support real medical decisions would be a natural next step.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence, where I built computer vision and NLP projects in PyTorch. I also bring industry experience in SQL, data pipelines and dashboards from SAP data & analytics work.

achievements.impact: I built a PyTorch retinal OCT classifier on EfficientNet-B0 reaching 94.11% accuracy on a 968-image test set
in my thesis team I evaluated and tuned an EfficientNet-B0 model and compared EasyOCR configurations
I used SQL analysis, data validation and reconciliation to keep reporting accurate across HR, finance, supply chain and procurement

letter.problems_section: I would support your ML engineers by building Python tools to statistically compare models, checking for confounding variables, and helping test and validate imaging models. My Master's courses in Bayesian Data Assimilation and Sequential Decision Making are strengthening my statistics, and I am motivated to deepen it further.
letter.closing: I am available immediately for up to 20 hours per week and am happy to relocate to Munich. I would be glad to discuss how I can contribute.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
